name: Dumbbell wrist curl
formTips: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, wrists just past your knees
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing up
Let the dumbbells lower until your wrists are bent down
Curl your wrists up as high as they go; only your hands move
commonMistakes: Lifting the forearms off the thighs
Going too heavy and jerking the weight
Using a short range of motion
Letting the dumbbells roll out of the fingers
